newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish crown seen firming against mark.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish crown seen firming against mark.

text.p: Technical analysis suggests that the Danish crown could in the near term strengthen further against the mark from its current level, the highest against the German currency in almost seven years.
"I expect the crown to be stable or a little firmer against the mark," Unibank Markets analyst Jan Bylov told Reuters on Tuesday.
He added that if the current trend remained unchanged the crown could trade at a mean 3.7935-3.7975 to the mark over the next month or two.
Central bank data showed the crown at a median rate of 3.8068 to the mark on Monday the Danish currency's strongest level against the German money since late July 1990.
A dealer said that crown strength was a product of central bank stabilisation policy, which discouraged speculation.
"Big foreign houses still see opportunities to make money on the other Scandinavian currencies but they've given up on the (Danish) crown," he said.
